text: This report recommends that the name "Bistro Lane" be approved to identify an existing public lane located west of Yonge Street, extending north from Wellesley Street West. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Bistro Lane" for an existing public lane located west of Yonge Street, extending north from Wellesley Street West.
